name: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited
summary: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited specializes in providing cable television networks and internet connectivity. Their service portfolio includes personal video recording capabilities and diverse broadband packages, such as fiber-optic options, catering to both residential and commercial clients. The company was established on November 12, 1984, and its main office is situated in Mumbai, India.
